name: slide-commit

frames.best_why: Handle is partway along the track with white stretching behind it and the pay label still visible.

tagline: Drag a pay slider across and it unfurls into a green Paid pill.
summary: An invoice card with a slide-to-pay control. Dragging the round handle to the end starts the payment, spins a loader, then the whole bar turns green with a tick and Paid.
appearance: A dark rounded invoice card shows a payee, a large amount, an invoice tag and two summary rows. At the bottom a dark track holds a white round handle with an arrow and a muted Slide to pay label; on success the track becomes a solid green pill.
behaviour: Dragging the handle across the track streaks white behind it. Reaching the end fires the payment, shows a brief spinner, then the bar swaps to green with a tick and Paid, and after a pause slides back to idle.
demo_content: Invoice card for Northwind Studio, $1,250.00, Invoice #2041, paid from Checking •• 4821, arriving today 3:40 PM.
search_phrases: payment card with slider to pay
use_when: A destructive or financial action needs a deliberate gesture so a stray tap cannot trigger it.
avoid_when: It needs a wide track; at 280px it is tight for long labels and the gesture is awkward on tiny screens.
customise: Labels, confirm, done and error callbacks, four colours, width, height, radius, speed and spring tuning are props, plus disabled, icon and hold time.
weight_why: One bar and a handful of motion values; work happens only during a slide or status change.

a11y.note: Full slider keyboard semantics and a polite live status; the drag gesture itself has no text hint for screen readers.

issues: The Slide to pay hint is faint grey on the dark track and the handle covers it as you drag.
polish_why: The slide, spinner and green payoff read clearly; the invoice card is tidy and restrained.
